title: Pakistan inflation could hit double digits if oil stays above $100 per barrel: report - Profit by Pakistan Today
sentence: According to the brokerage firm’s estimates, a Brent crude price of around $100 per barrel could push average inflation to 10.92% in the fourth quarter of FY26, followed by 9.33% in the first quarter of FY27, 7.47% in the second quarter and 8.22% in the third quarter.

title: Finance ministry sees June inflation at 11-12% - Business Recorder
sentence: The headline inflation clocked in at 11.7% on a year-on-year (YoY) basis in May 2026, which was the highest reading since June 2024, according to Arif Habib Limited (AHL).

title: SBP keeps policy rate unchanged at 11.5% as inflation outlook stabilises - Business Recorder
sentence: In a poll conducted by Topline Securities, 49% of respondents expect the policy rate to remain unchanged on Jun 15, 2026, MPC meeting.
